'''Goat Milk''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from a [[Goat]] by using a [[Milk Pail]]. A Goat produces one Goat Milk per two days if fed on the prior days. 

When a goat has a sufficient [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]] and [[Animals#Mood|mood]] level, it can produce a [[Large Goat Milk]], which is more valuable.

==Artisan Goods==
:''See also: [[Animal Products Profitability]]''
Goat Milk can be used to make the following [[Artisan Goods]].  Note that regular Goat Milk always produces regular quality [[Goat Cheese]], while [[Large Goat Milk]] always produces gold-quality [[Goat Cheese]].  The quality of the milk is not a factor.

Goat Cheese may be aged in [[Cask]]s to increase its quality.

==Tailoring==
Goat Milk is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt024|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a white dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Goat Milk is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
